trustPage.title: Verification and trust
trustPage.lead: We only label what was actually checked, and we say clearly what we don't check.
trustPage.identity: The professional uploaded an identity document. A staff member compared the name and photo with the profile. The label shows the date of the check.
trustPage.qual: Each diploma, licence or certificate is checked individually. If the professional changes the details or the document, the label is removed until it is checked again.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers to the main questions.

items.a: In this first version the platform is free for families and professionals. You agree the price of the service directly with the professional.

items.q: Does sending a request mean the professional will definitely come?
items.a: No. Your request goes to the Carely team: we call you, clarify the details and check the professional's availability. If the chosen professional is busy, we will suggest another suitable one.
A staff member compared an identity document with the profile details. It is not a safety guarantee.

items.q: How will I get in touch with the professional?
items.a: The Carely team will put you in touch with the professional, with your consent. Phone numbers are not published on the site.

items.q: Do I need to sign up to send a request?
items.a: No. Your name and phone number are enough. You can also simply call us.
Yes. In your request, say on which days and hours you need help and for how long. We will clarify the details on the phone.

items.q: How do I become a professional?
items.a: Sign up, complete your profile and submit it for review. It's published once approved.
Reviews are published only after moderation and must relate to a service that was actually provided.

aboutPage.title: About Carely
aboutPage.lead: A simple way to find care and everyday support in Armenia.
aboutPage.p1: Carely connects people who need care and assistance with independent professionals, making it easier to find the right helper for your family and everyday life.
aboutPage.p2: The platform features offers for childcare, elderly care, patient care, disability care and pet care, as well as nursing services, personal assistance and home help.
aboutPage.p3: Here you can explore professionals’ profiles, experience and skills, compare offers and contact them directly. You agree the working conditions, hours and payment directly with the professional.
aboutPage.p4: We value clear and transparent information: profiles show only the checks that have actually been carried out. Professionals work independently and are solely responsible for the services they provide.

contactPage.lead: Write to us with any question. Your message is saved and reviewed by the support team.

terms.p: Carely.am is an information platform for finding care and household-help professionals and getting in touch with them. The platform does not itself provide the care services presented on it.

terms.h: Arrangements between the parties and the professional’s responsibility
terms.p: The choice of professional and the agreement on service terms, price and payment are made directly between the customer and the professional. Each professional is solely responsible for the services they provide and for their own acts and omissions, in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Armenia.

To the extent permitted by law, Carely.am is not liable for the quality of services provided by independent professionals, for any breach of arrangements on their part, or for any damage they cause. This provision does not limit the platform’s liability under law for its own acts or omissions.
Before working with a professional, we recommend verifying their identity, experience, references and, where necessary, professional qualifications, and agreeing the terms of service in writing.
Users are responsible for the accuracy of their details and the security of their account.
Sending a request does not guarantee a service. An arrangement is confirmed after the professional accepts and the customer confirms.
Verification labels reflect only the specific check that was performed and are not a safety guarantee.
Reviews are published after moderation and must relate to a service that was actually provided.

privacy.p: Account details (name, email, phone), profile information, request details and verification documents.
To operate the platform, process requests, perform verification and provide support.
Contact details are visible only to participants of a confirmed request. Verification documents only to authorised staff.
Private documents are stored separately with no public access. Every view is logged.
You can ask for your data to be corrected or deleted by contacting support.
